Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 0  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified "4:05 in the afternoon" as the time when the student's shadow would be shortest, due to a fundamental misunderstanding of solar physics. Shadows are generally shortest at solar noon (around 12:00 PM standard time or slightly adjusted under Daylight Saving Time), when the sun is at its highest point in the sky. The mistake stemmed from overcomplication and misinterpretation of the relationship between solar noon, shadow length, and Daylight Saving Time adjustments. Instead of relying on general knowledge that shadows are shortest during solar noon, the Planner introduced ideas about thermal inertia and incorrectly calculated later afternoon times as optimal, contradicting the ground truth.
